title: The Lanes at noon
logline: The bowling alley's sign in daylight, off, every dead tube visible as a gray glass shape. The sequence has never drawn it by day. Absent; nobody in the lot.

panels.composition: A bowling alley's neon sign at noon, switched off, its tubes gray glass shapes against the roofline, an empty lot, flat light.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a bowling alley's neon sign at noon switched off with its tubes showing as gray glass shapes against the roofline and an empty parking lot in flat light, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
